description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing and automation in a Perforce (p4) and git integration context. It includes functions for setting up repositories, adding files, testing keyword scrubbing, and managing interactions between Perforce and git repositories, with various test scenarios involving RCS keywords, text scrubbing, and conflict resolution.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Defines Python scripts for scrubbing RCS keywords from text files, used in tests.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks that the keyword scrubbing for files with +k attributes works correctly.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Checks that the keyword scrubbing for files with +ko attributes works correctly.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a test file with RCS keyword lines for testing.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a line with the current date to a file, then submits it in Perforce.
